The credential-sync branch silently changes the return shape that direct-dereferencing call sites depend on. This only triggers when the sync endpoint is configured, but it's a real behavioral break introduced by the diff.

judged_text: refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response in sync mode but callers were written to consume the transport-specific object (axios response or pre-parsed token), so the two shapes are silently conflated. With CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, every call site that dereferences the return value directly instead of passing it through a Response-handling helper reads undefined fields and writes garbage into credential.key.
